Date: 22.10.2026
To,
The Senior Manager (Engineering)
Central Warehousing Corporation
Regional Office, Guwahati
Subject: Construction of Cement Concrete Approach Road at CW, Mankachar — Request for Extension of Time up to 03.12.2026 — reg.
Reference:
LOA No. CWC RO-GHY0ENGG/26/2024-ENGG_GHY dated 19.02.2026.
Your office’s letter dated 16.06.2026 granting Extension of Time up to 30.10.2026.
Our letter dated 22.09.2026 regarding site hindrances and rainfall.
Sir,
The above work (stipulated completion 05.07.2026; revised contract value ₹1,65,73,444.20) was extended up to 30.10.2026 vide reference (2), considering completion of piling works by 09.07.2026.
However, the work could not be completed by 30.10.2026 due to the following hindrances, which arose after the period considered in the earlier EOT and were beyond our control:
Piling works: completed only on 22.07.2026, i.e. 13 days beyond 09.07.2026, owing to continuous rain and waterlogging. The road works could start only thereafter.
Rainfall: as per the daily site rain log (enclosed), rain was recorded on 33 days between 10.07.2026 and 21.09.2026 — July 19 days, August 3 days and September 11 days. GSB, WMM and concreting could not be done on these days and on the following days due to waterlogging.
Accordingly, the net hindrance works out to 34 days. As on date, GSB and WMM have been laid and DLC is in progress. The balance work – DLC, design-mix CC pavement (PQC), curing, joint sealing and finishing – shall be completed within this period, as per the revised programme at Annexure-II.
You are, therefore, requested to kindly grant Extension of Time of 34 days, i.e. from 31.10.2026 up to 03.12.2026, without levy of compensation under Clause 5 of GCC.
Thanking you,
Yours faithfully,
For M/s Shiva Buildtech Pvt. Ltd.
Authorized Signatory
Encl.: Annexure-I: Rain Days Report with Daily Rain Log (09.06.2026 to 21.09.2026). Annexure-II: Revised Programme/Bar Chart (22.10.2026 to 03.12.2026).
Copy to: 1. The Regional Manager, CWC, RO Guwahati. 2. The Warehouse Manager, CW Mankachar.
